name: GenOffice
desc: AI office suite for PC and Mac, free, ad-free and openly licensed.
desc_zh: 面向 PC 和 Mac 的 AI 办公套件，免费、无广告且开源
solves: An office suite that talks to you costs a subscription and reads your documents. GenOffice publishes its code, runs on the desktop and keeps the files on the machine.
solves_zh: 会对话的办公套件通常要订阅，还会读你的文档。GenOffice 开源、跑在桌面端，文件留在本机。
best_for: You want documents, sheets and slides with AI built in without another account.
best_for_zh: 你想要内置 AI 的文档、表格和幻灯片，又不想再多一个账号。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.genspark.ai/blog , then the Genspark product menu）。 Announced 2026-08-03 as an open-source release; the post says the alpha was built by one engineer in a week for $10,000 in tokens and invites people to download and contribute. Missing from the ledger, which holds only the Genspark agent platform (2024-06-01) for this vendor. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.genspark.ai/blog/genoffice-open-source-ai-office
